anomalies.observed: The INA219AIDCNR symbol on the Power sheet has pin 8 labeled SDA and connected to I2C2_SDA_FCC, while pin 6 is labeled A1 and tied to GND. The standard INA219 pinout has pin 6 as SDA and pin 8 as A1.
anomalies.expected: Per the INA219AIDCNR datasheet, pin 6 is SDA and pin 8 is A1. The schematic should connect I2C2_SDA_FCC to pin 6 and tie pin 8 (A1) to GND for address 0x40.

evidence.quote: U1 INA219AIDCNR: pin 8 SDA (net I2C2_SDA_FCC), pin 6 A1 (tied to GND)
Current/voltage sensor | Hades (top sheet) | TI INA219AIDCNR, I2C addr 0x40, across R1 = 10 mΩ shunt

anomalies.impact: The I2C data line is connected to the address pin A1 instead of SDA, and the real SDA pin is grounded. The INA219 will not communicate on I2C and the address will be incorrect, disabling current/voltage sensing.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains a pin-mapping error on the INA219 current/voltage sensor: the SDA and A1 pins are swapped relative to the standard INA219AIDCNR pinout, which would prevent I2C communication and break the current/voltage sensing function.
